cases.input: Claim W-2201: 2022 electric crossover, 41,200 km. Drive motor inverter failed. Owner reports a warning light that appeared two weeks ago; the vehicle is inside the powertrain warranty window.
Claim W-2202: 2021 sedan, 96,000 km. Brake pads and discs worn below the minimum. No defect reported, routine servicing only.
Claim W-2203: 2023 hybrid, 18,900 km. Battery coolant leak. The VIN has an open safety campaign for the same coolant circuit.

Claim W-2204: 2020 diesel van, 132,000 km. A failed water pump stripped the timing belt and damaged the cylinder head. Vehicle is past the base warranty; the extended powertrain cover has a consequential-damage exclusion.
Claim W-2205: 2024 electric van, 9,700 km. Charging port latch will not release. Registered in the EMEA region.
Claim W-2206: 2022 crossover, 55,000 km. Owner Anna Kowalska, mobile +48 600 000 000, reports a rattle from the front subframe that started after a repair at 48,000 km.
